pose: leaning into a tight turn with one wing cover lifted

composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a small beetle as an enamel sculpture with tiny roller wheels integrated beneath its feet. Its pomegranate-red wing covers overlap the body, with one cover lifted just enough to reveal a gold hinge-like detail. The beetle leans into a tight turn, keeping its legs compact and antennae curled inward. Two small dark eyes convey delighted confidence without a broad cartoon face. Render the enamel reflections, mint-colored metal wheels, and a few fine joints with precision. Use a pale blue-gray background and one curved contact shadow beneath the wheels. The movement stays self-contained inside the circular avatar area, with no track, speed lettering, or surrounding props.
